thread.title: The biggest stock-market winners on the best day for jobs news in 10 months

author: Philip van Doorn
title: The biggest stock-market winners on the best day for jobs news in 10 months
text:
The biggest stock-market winners on the best day for jobs news in 10 months MarketWatch 2 hrs ago Philip van Doorn Friday was a day of significant gains for U.S. stocks, after the Labor Department’s reported the U.S. economy added 312,000 jobs during December, well above the consensus forecast of a 182,000 increase among economists polled by MarketWatch.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) jumped 747 points or 3.3% to close at 23,433.16, for its best performance since Dec. 26, when it surged 5%. (Before Dec. 26, the Dow’s best day was Aug. 26, 2015, when it climbed 4%.) The S&P 500 index (SPX) clambered up 3.4%, while the Nasdaq Composite Index (COMP) leapt 4.3%.
Higher stock prices generally held despite a statement from President Trump later in the session that the partial shutdown of the U.S. government might last months or years, after he and Democratic Party leaders in Congress again failed to settle their dispute over funding Trump’s proposed border wall.
